cat > /tmp/t.py <<'EOF'
import os, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app')

def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR='127.0.0.1', MASTER_PORT='29511')
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    B, I, O = 3, 8, 4
    x = torch.randn(B, I)
    mw = torch.randn(O, I)
    ref = torch.nn.Linear(I, O)
    with torch.no_grad():
        ref.weight.copy_(mw); ref.bias.zero_()
    yr = ref(x); yr.sum().backward()

    c = ColumnParallelLinear(I, O, True, mw)
    yc = c(x); assert torch.allclose(yc, yr), (yc, yr)
    yc.sum().backward()
    gw = ref.weight.grad.chunk(ws, 0)[rank]; gb = ref.bias.grad.chunk(ws,0)[rank]
    assert torch.allclose(c.weight.grad, gw) and torch.allclose(c.bias.grad, gb)
    assert c.weight.shape == (O//ws, I) and c.bias.shape == (O//ws,)

    # row parallel: input pre-scattered
    mw2 = torch.randn(O, I)
    ref2 = torch.nn.Linear(I, O)
    with torch.no_grad(): ref2.weight.copy_(mw2); ref2.bias.zero_()
    x2 = torch.randn(B, I); x2r = x2.clone().requires_grad_()
    y2 = ref2(x2r); y2.sum().backward()
    r = RowParallelLinear(I, O, True, mw2)
    xs = x2.chunk(ws, -1)[rank].contiguous()
    yy = r(xs); assert torch.allclose(yy, y2, atol=1e-6), (yy,y2)
    yy.sum().backward()
    assert torch.allclose(r.weight.grad, ref2.weight.grad.chunk(ws,1)[rank])
    assert torch.allclose(r.bias.grad, ref2.bias.grad)
    assert r.weight.shape == (O, I//ws) and r.bias.shape == (O,)
    if rank==0: print("ws",ws,"OK")
    dist.destroy_process_group()

if __name__=='__main__':
    for ws in (1,2,4):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
EOF
